notes.title: Cycle Of Life Update
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/522539873717541ad6bb4c47480bc7a20ec80ace.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/edfdb8d208812efc521e8c3442203ade0f53ffb9.png[/img][/url]
Birth: Baby fish - new fish are now baby fish! feed(and love) them enough and they will grow into adults
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/44ea775204a29d61f59351eb2713966d04765112.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/00a1cd653d418f7bbc91bc517c2e4bf97bddaffd.png[/img][/url]
Death: Fish put in a tank with their dislikes now have a small chance to die on collision.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/f9ad0e6f9fc16b2994dce2b78a628214ccf8cf7e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/99e5f43abebde70b220d9b95e8c6f9e622fe6b33.png[/img][/url]
Sustenence: Food mechanics reworked. 
	- Food has multiple "shakes" of food, with less food points but overall more food per food item.
	- Babies require a set number of food points to grow up.
	- New food added
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/1bd79bb7a1884b82a097eee3d05e15fcc7b1789b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/ed05b70fccd7d345e50c58285b27fe47edf3cf6f.png[/img][/url]
Gravel: We got 6 colors of gravelly goodness, increases fish happiness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694807/2a4261ad6e482714d88cf143a4eb38520f7f6b9d.png[/img]
balancing/bugfixes
	- silvertip save bug - Saves were corrupted when using silver tip (sorry!)
	- a bit of balancing

notes.title: Music, empty tank button, bugfixes and fish happiness update
notes.content:
Music added, empty tank button, various bugfixes.
Apologies to those who encountered bugs, we have 2 more in an upcoming patch and more sound, thanks to the community for helping us weed the bugs out! :)
<3 <3 <3 
You are all amazing :D
